# OntoUML JSON schema provenance

`ontouml-schema.json` is an unmodified copy of
`OntoUML/ontouml-schema`, `dist/ontouml-schema.json`, retrieved on 2026-10-05.

- Upstream: https://github.com/OntoUML/ontouml-schema
- Upstream Git blob: `7608e50f9e020fbadc782fd86d6b0c66e3b85b65`
- Schema ID: `https://w3id.org/ontouml/schema/v1.0.2`
- SHA-256: `d79318a3a4761c78156bfa707f794756cc7be24e8f98dbbf92b261f28a124783`
- License: Apache 2.0, see `LICENSE-ontouml-schema.txt`.

Schema validation checks document structure. It does not establish OntoUML
well-formedness, reference integrity, modal constraints or absence of anti-patterns.
The builder separately checks identifiers and validates each nested element.
